## 10. Instructions for Completing Human Decisions
1. Open `http://localhost:3003/window-review-r132` in a browser
2. Review each anonymous region in shuffled order
3. Initial view shows only original source crop; reveal evidence overlays after first observation
4. Select one allowed verdict from the right panel
5. If verdict is `CONTAINS_MULTIPLE_SEPARATE_WINDOWS`, enter positive integer quantity
6. Add notes in the notes field
7. Click Save Progress after each region; data persists in localStorage and server
8. Completed decisions are stored at: `evidence/code06/phase-b-clean/human-review-r1.3.2/human-review-decisions.json`

Do not calculate a final window count until a real human completes the review.
